key_insight: The paper proves that, in incompressible MHD turbulence, simultaneous transfer of cross-helicity uniquely determines a pair-exchange decomposition of nonlinear energy transfer within triad interactions.
engineering_relevance: This provides a mathematically rigorous way to interpret and model energy exchange pathways in MHD turbulence, improving analysis of plasma, astrophysical, and fusion-relevant flows.
method: Analyze triad interactions in incompressible magnetohydrodynamics.
Use conservation and simultaneous transfer of cross-helicity to constrain the nonlinear transfer structure.
Derive a unique pair-exchange representation for energy and cross-helicity transfer.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a theoretical proof rather than a numerical dataset, showing uniqueness of the pair-exchange formulation under the stated MHD constraints.
watch_item: The result depends on incompressibility and the availability of cross-helicity transfer, so it may not extend unchanged to compressible or differently constrained turbulence models.
